petitions.exact_text: Armour half off and stacked in the order it goes back on. She has braced the gap's lip with two stakes and a plank, and she tests the plank every time she passes it.
petitions.ground: Present-behaviour characterisation of a person who is actually on stage. The armour stacked in the order it goes back on and the plank tested every single pass are observed repeat actions, not inferred motive -- bible §6 rule 1's permitted class, and the ruin's one character-bearing peak. No counter flags it (closer 0, anon 0, neg 0), which is exactly the §10 blind spot the petition route exists for.

petitions.exact_text: Stakes driven at intervals nobody eyeballed, string run between them, chalk numbers on every one. The line stops dead at the mouth of the pedestal court and does not go in.
petitions.ground: The work is the survey discipline (driven at intervals, string, chalk numbers on every stake) and then the line stopping dead at the court mouth -- information the player acts on, in a region whose content is emptiness. `nobody` here is a present-indefinite, not an inferred absent agent: the adopted RE_ANON split puts it outside the four §6.4 motive-words (someone/somebody/whoever/whatever). Counter-invisible otherwise.

petitions.exact_text: The floor is simply gone here, one span of it, edge to edge. Dropped stone comes back as a sound and not much of one.
petitions.ground: The bible citation is binding here, not decorative: 'Dropped stone comes back as a sound and not much of one' IS the depth measurement -- zero inference, zero agent, and it is the string that sells the gap the gallery_line_anchored gate exists for. Flattening it to a stated distance would cost the only information the player has.

petitions.exact_text: [Detect Magic] — Wardwork, and awake: it does not flare and settle the way a bound ward should. It holds one low steady note, like a breath nobody has to let out, and you have felt that note somewhere else.
petitions.ground: The simile is the diagnostic. 'It does not flare and settle the way a bound ward should. It holds one low steady note, like a breath nobody has to let out' is how the player learns this ward is awake and one-directional, and it seeds the Act-V POURING reveal on the same prop. `nobody` is a present-indefinite (see the RE_ANON split), not an absent-agent inference; the ward's behaviour is directly observed.

petitions.exact_text: [Detect Magic] — Every reading you have taken lines up at once: the inn's frame, the ruin's socket, the seam back down the hall, the hollow west of Riverfarm. Not four wards. One lattice, and this door is where it drains to. Something behind this stone has been drinking Liscor's oldest work since before Liscor. Pisces uses a word you have never heard him use in public.
petitions.ground: GRANTED as a §1.4 exception at 5 sentences (ceiling 2). Two independent grounds. (a) The prop's byte-frozen holdout sibling at $.entities[8].skill_uses.detect_magic.variants[0].toast measures 7 sentences by the tooling's own RE_SENT counter and is UNTOUCHABLE, so a 2-sentence ceiling on this arm would sit below the floor the holdout already sets on the same prop -- incoherent. (b) The length is fact-carrying: the four-site lattice enumeration (inn's frame, ruin's socket, hall seam, Riverfarm hollow) is the evidence for the Act-V reveal, and facts outrank the ceiling. §1.4 loosens only by petition with the string in hand; this is that petition.

petitions.exact_text: [Observe] — You take the runes in order, the way you would read a sentence. The turns repeat at a fixed interval. The pantry frame does exactly that, at exactly that interval, and this one is worn deeper: it has been doing it longer. Behind you, Pisces says nothing.
petitions.ground: GRANTED at 4 sentences (ceiling 2). The interval-and-wear comparison is the reveal's proof -- same hand, same fixed interval as the pantry frame, worn deeper therefore older -- and cannot be compressed without fact loss. The closing Pisces beat ('Behind you, Pisces says nothing.') is worth its cost under §3 and is the replacement for the issue-named `which from him is applause` geometry that this same field used to carry, so cutting it would re-open the indicted string's hole.
